observed_mechanics: 0x00b7e380 8d 41 2c - LEA EAX,dword ptr [ECX + 0x2c]: the receiver in ECX is taken as a base and the 32-bit word at receiver+0x2c is computed as an address in EAX.
0x00b7e383 c3 - RET: single exit; the callee pops nothing, so stack cleanup is 0 bytes and owned by the caller.
The body is 4 bytes and contains no branch, no call, no flag test, no register save and no loop: the computation at +0x2c is unconditional, so every entry computes the same address.
No instruction reads receiver+0x00, so no vtable pointer field is claimed on the receiver object; the vtable image is described as a standalone table instead.

V1-VFT rule: 0x00b7e380 is slot 38 of the vptr-backed vftable at 0x013ff648 (and also 0x01489090, 0x014893b0), so it is a non-static virtual member function; the callee pops nothing and no stack word is read as an argument, so the receiver is in ECX and the convention is __thiscall with 0 ordinary stack arguments.
